intern.title: THE INTERN
intern.one_liner: Three internships, 214 connections, one mentor who texts.
intern.perk: WARM INTROS: 2 referrals. A referral gets a human to read your CV and skips knockout filters.
intern.flaw: BIG-TECH AURA: startups think you'll leave in 6 months. Your algorithms are rusty.
intern.dana_opener: Three internships. Why didn't they keep you? ...Budget freeze. Right. Same.
intern.plan_b_line: Your old internship mentor liked your first video. Then unfollowed.

graduate.title: THE GRADUATE
graduate.one_liner: One diploma, one student loan, zero callbacks.
graduate.perk: DIPLOMA: passes 'degree required' filters. TEXTBOOK ANSWER: wider zone on your first tech question.
graduate.flaw: ENTRY-LEVEL PARADOX: '1+ years' filters reject you unless your Experience line is Polished.
graduate.dana_opener: A fresh grad. The ATS wants 3 years. I want to hear what you built.
graduate.plan_b_line: Your diploma now holds up the ring light.

self_taught.title: THE SELF-TAUGHT
self_taught.one_liner: 437 hours of tutorials, 6 languages, 2 bus transfers.
self_taught.perk: BREADTH: 6 skills on your CV. SCRAPPY BUILDER: startups love shipped projects.
self_taught.flaw: THE LONG WAY: 2-bus commute, no degree, knowledge gaps, no team stories yet.
self_taught.dana_opener: Our ATS hates 'no degree'. I don't. Show me what you shipped.
self_taught.commute_line: Home Wi-Fi: one bar. Library: two buses away.
self_taught.plan_b_line: Your course is called 'Self-Taught, Self-Employed'. It sells.
